summary: BI-985F4EC9. Migration 20261014100000_device_code_session_purpose adds the GitHubDeviceFlowPurpose enum and a nullable DeviceCodeSession.purpose column so a GitHub device-flow login is routed to the credential slot chosen when it started (hive-contribution, or the new github-repository-controller CredentialEntry providerId). Additive; no new model; CredentialEntry gains no columns.
affectedCopies: DeviceCodeSession.purpose, written by initiateDeviceFlow and read by pollDeviceFlow (apps/web/lib/actions/github-device-flow.ts)

CredentialEntry row with providerId github-repository-controller (existing columns, encrypted secretRef via encryptSecret), read by loadManagedRepositoryStatus (apps/web/lib/forge/managed-repository-access.ts) and by resolveGithubToken with preferRepositoryController (issue intake)
PlatformDevConfig.upstreamRemoteUrl (existing column), now written by saveManagedRepository (apps/web/lib/actions/managed-repository.ts) when the operator saves a repository

privacyAssessment.sensitivity: internal: a closed purpose label on a short-lived login session. The credential it routes is a secret and stays encrypted at rest in the existing CredentialEntry.secretRef; it is never returned, logged or placed in attention payloads.
privacyAssessment.reviewDisposition: The column follows the session row, which is consumed or deleted on expiry (15-minute device-code lifetime).

migration.name: 20261014100000_device_code_session_purpose
migration.backfill: None: existing rows keep NULL, which pollDeviceFlow reads as hive-contribution, the only purpose that existed before. CREATE TYPE is guarded by duplicate_object and ADD COLUMN uses IF NOT EXISTS, so the migration is re-runnable.
migration.rollback: Forward-only. Older code never reads the column. Rollback means reverting the code; a controller session started on new code and polled on old code would store to hive-contribution, so finish or let in-flight sessions expire (15 minutes) before reverting.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Existing model (transient device-flow sessions, deleted on consume or expiry); the column follows the row.

fields.reason: Closed operational label (hive-contribution | repository-controller) naming which credential slot a login is for. Not a data-subject attribute.
fields.provenance: Set by initiateDeviceFlow from the caller's requested purpose (default hive-contribution); BI-985F4EC9.
